comment: MEDIUM-07: benchmark baseline for regression detection. See ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md §3 MEDIUM-07.
benchmark: tests/benchmarks/benchmark_recall.py — 50 nodes, 20 queries, get_context recall + latency

recall_at_3.comment: Minimum acceptable recall@3. With sentence-transformers (multilingual-e5-small) we observed 100%; we set the floor to 60% which matches the script's 'good' target — anything below indicates a real regression in retrieval quality.

avg_query_ms.comment: Maximum average single-query latency in ms. Observed ~91ms on dev machine with multilingual-e5-small. Set to 500ms (≈5×) to absorb CI jitter while still flagging genuine regressions.

max_query_ms.comment: Maximum p100 single-query latency in ms. Catches outlier slowdowns even if average looks fine.

how_to_update: Run `python tests/benchmarks/update_baseline.py` to refresh observed values, then commit baseline.json. Tighten min_value / max_value thresholds when warranted.
